entry.title: XP-08 1.0.0
entry.summary: An XP-80-style PCM synth that plays Roland SR-JV80 boards from your own dumps: four board slots, their patches, four tones with pitch, filter and amp envelopes, LFOs, mod matrix, 12/24 dB and ladder filters, all 40 EFX types, chorus, reverb. Needs your own board (and optional JV-1080/JV-880) dumps. Akai MPC Plugin SDK; Gen1 and Gen2.
